These public Huawei catalog responses were captured for `sa-brazil-1` (São Paulo) on
2026-09-28. `expected.json` was generated by the runtime before the architecture
refactor, using defaults, multiple quantities, shorter usage, and monthly billing
where supported. DMS was evaluated directly from its existing bundle because its
runtime registration was missing. EVS was supplied its existing `diskPricing`
catalog directly because its form used the wrong response key.

Keep these responses fixed when checking refactors. They establish behavior and
precision for a known input; they do not claim that the prices remain current.
The EIP monthly case intentionally records an unavailable estimate for its default
selection. Hydration tests additionally verify that saved products can be edited.
